segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report the serum absorbs without adding heaviness or grease, with a couple specifically praising it as good for oily skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry-combination skin consistently report strong hydration, plumper and softer skin, and no added heaviness.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including a couple who are also acne-prone, report no irritation or breakouts despite the serum's scent; one reviewer with very reactive, sensitive skin reports the product, like other Elemis items she tried, caused hives.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including some who describe a T-zone that is oily while other areas run dry, report the serum balances hydration across the face without causing breakouts or excess oil.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their mid-40s to 70s report firmer skin and visibly softer fine lines with regular use.

concerns.aging: The great majority of reviewers report firmer, plumper skin and visibly softer fine lines within one to a few weeks; a couple say they noticed plumping without a real change in wrinkles, at least in the time they had used it.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers across skin types describe deep, lasting hydration and a plumper, less dry feel, including some with especially dry skin who see it as excellent.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers, including one who is combination and acne-prone, report no breakouts and even some clearing of minor blemishes; one reviewer says she broke out more after switching to this serum.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report the serum does not add shine or heaviness, with one noting her T-zone felt less oily after use.

Before I started using this product, I had some uneven texture, dullness, and occasional dry patches, especially around my cheeks. Now, my skin feels significantly smoother and more hydrated, with a more even tone. There's a healthy glow that wasn't there before, and my skin just looks more "awake." The serum has a light, elegant scent—not overpowering at all. It smells slightly botanical, but in a very refined and calming way. It feels like a little spa moment every time I apply it. It feels like the product is working with my skin, not just sitting on top of it.
